QuestInfo.name: To the Excavation Site!
QuestInfo.0: There's an announcement posted on the Relic Excavation Association Board in camp...
QuestInfo.1: - Announcement - \n\nUndead skeletons have appeared in the Excavation Site and are causing quite a ruckus. Any brave adventurer who helps eliminate these monsters will be rewarded. Please see #r#p9040002##k in the #b#m102040200##k for details.
QuestInfo.2: You answered Sean's call for help.

1.0: Darned moving fossils... Huh? What are you doing here?
1.1: Ah, you must be here because of the announcement I posted! Excellent! I could really use your help!
